_about: Tracked registry for FailureClassifier.ts. A failure is labelled ONLY when it matches an entry here AND the entry's breadth rule holds. Everything else stays 'unclassified'. Add an entry only with live evidence and a KI reference; npm run check:failure-labels validates this file. A label is a hint, never a verdict.

ambiguousCodes.note: Invalid ... summary response: seen both as a genuine RBAC denial (contacts.rbac.spec.ts, contact shared without its company) and with staging search-index lag (KI-43). Never used as evidence of a cause.
Invalid contact/company id: Kylas RBAC enforcement, also seen when a just-created record is not yet visible. Never used as evidence of a cause.

signatures.title: connection refused (ECONNREFUSED)
signatures.label: environment-suspected
errorPatternNotes: a refused connection reported by the browser
signatures.why: The error text itself says the TCP connection was refused, so no application or test logic is involved. One test is enough because the text is explicit. KI-43 is the closest environment entry; there is no dedicated one.

signatures.title: HTTP 502/503/504 from the API
signatures.label: environment-suspected
errorPatternNotes: a gateway error (HTTP 502, 503 or 504) reported by the API
signatures.why: Gateway errors mean the upstream service was unreachable or overloaded. Two tests are required because a captured 5xx is not proven to be the request that failed the test; one stray 502 should not label a failure.

signatures.title: search lookup returned no match for a record
signatures.label: environment-suspected
errorPatternNotes: a dropdown option that never became visible after a search
a dropdown that showed no options after a search
a live search that returned no options
dropdown options that did not appear after a search
a list search that found nothing after a create (the failing step is a retried list search)

askKylasTeam.question: Is the staging search indexer / event consumer for deals, contacts, leads and companies stalled or backlogged? Was there a staging deploy or reindex between 10 and 14 Oct 2026?
askKylasTeam.observation: A deal created through the API stayed absent from GET /v1/search/deal/lookup for 188 s in a manual probe. That probe is not repeated by this run.

signatures.why: Sandbox 38690038228 had about 75 failed or flaky tests that were a react-select or list search missing a record. The classifier cannot see that the record was just created, so the breadth rule carries the weight: 8 is above the 3 flaky tests seen in a whole healthy run (stage 37953246450, main 38396600241) and well below the 37+ lookup-miss tests in the bad run; 2 modules rules out one broken page.

signatures.title: HTTP 500 01403004 on POST /v3/reports
signatures.label: application-bug-suspected
signatures.kiRef: Meeting report fails first Save with HTTP 500 (2026-08-25)
signatures.why: A specific status, error code and endpoint documented as a backend defect (first Save 500, immediate retry succeeds). The code is specific enough that one test is enough.

signatures.title: client-side JavaScript crash
signatures.label: application-bug-suspected
errorPatternNotes: a JavaScript "is not a function" error
a JavaScript read of a property of undefined or null
signatures.why: The same text can come from test code, so a label needs either a known-issue match for the failing code or the same crash in at least 2 tests.

signatures.title: HTTP 500 00903002 on PUT /products/{id}
signatures.label: application-bug-suspected
signatures.why: Main run 39534804354 (kylas-prod, observed 2026-10-21): PUT /products/{id} returned HTTP 500 code 00903002 "Something went wrong" for products 512133, 512136, 512140, 512141 and 512152 to 512170 in shards 2 and 4 and the P&S formFields job; the same edits passed on staging. Two tests are required because one captured 500 is not proven to be the request that failed the test; one module is enough because the endpoint is specific.

signatures.title: HTTP 400 000000 with empty errorDetails on POST /contacts/
signatures.label: application-bug-suspected
signatures.why: Main run 39470566009 (kylas-prod, observed 2026-10-20): POST /contacts/ returned HTTP 400 code 000000 "Something didn't work as expected" with empty errorDetails 112 times between 17:57 and 21:02 UTC; 19 contacts, 2 companies and 2 meetings tests were affected. Code 000000 is generic, so the body shape and a breadth of 5 tests across 2 modules are required before it labels anything.

signatures.title: backend service-discovery (DNS) failure behind the API
signatures.label: environment-suspected
errorPatterns: Failed to resolve '[^']+' and search domain query
errorPatternNotes: the API gateway could not resolve an internal service name (cluster DNS), as in 'Failed to resolve sd-sales and search domain query'
the API connection to an internal service closed before a response was sent
signatures.why: QA run 40477938102 (2026-10-27, traces read 2026-10-28): HTTP 400 code 000000 "Failed to resolve 'sd-sales' / 'sd-marketplace' / 'sd-rule' / 'sd-order-management' and search domain query for configured domains failed as well" on POST /v1/contacts/ (09:18 UTC), GET /v1/marketplace/apps/actions, POST /v1/rules/search/action-logs and GET /v1/quotations/layout/create (11:26 UTC), and "Connection prematurely closed BEFORE response" on GET /v1/quotations/layout/list (10:57 UTC). The error text names an internal service lookup, so no test or page logic is involved. The text only reaches the failure message since the create flows and the Quotations layout wait began including the response message, so it cannot match older runs. Two tests are required because one captured message is not proven to be the request that failed the test; one module is enough because the text is explicit.
